title: add after-section logic option and code comments
description:
## Overview
Addresses part of #28 (but not all, so keeping issue open)

- Allows more customized dropdown placement by adding `after-section` option
- Section is not case-sensitive
- If there is a typo or other error, the placement of the dropdown reverts back to the default (top of page)

## Testing
- Created example files and tested to ensure:
   - Case was insensitive
   - Fallback behavior was functional

title: Fix deep links into non-default content-switcher variants
description:
Resolves #35 

Anchor links to a heading inside a non-default variant did not work. The page showed the default variant, so the target section stayed hidden and the browser could not scroll to it. Support staff had to send multi-step workarounds to route customers to the right section (reported in PPDS-596).

Variants are hidden by JavaScript after the page loads, so the browser's native jump to the anchor happened before the target was hidden, and the scroll position was wrong once the other variants collapsed.

This change updates content-switcher.js to:

- Select the variant that owns the anchor target on page load, so a plain deep link selects the correct variant on its own.
- Re-scroll to the anchor after switching, once the layout settles.
- Switch variants and scroll when an in-page anchor click crosses into another variant (hashchange).
- Write the selected variant to the URL as ?version= on selector change, so the address bar is always a shareable link.

Initial variant precedence: anchor target, then ?version= parameter, then localStorage, then the selector default.
